daily.topThemeTitle: AI Surveillance and Classroom Policy Draw New Scrutiny
daily.topThemeBody: Brookings finds AI-powered school surveillance tools deployed disproportionately in low-income, high-minority districts, while EdSurge's on-the-ground reporting shows new edtech and screen-time guidance is easier to write than to apply in a real classroom.
